newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat on cenbank dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat on cenbank dlr sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 476.75/477.75 per dollar as the Central Bank intervened to bring the unit off afternoon lows of 478 per dollar, traders said.
But pressure on the exchange rate could ease later this week -- should yields on benchmark Central Bank six-month TEMs rise at Wednesday's regular auction, as is widely expected.
"A TEM rise could see an interesting flow of dollars into the Venezuelan market, other than those from the Central Bank," said one trader.
Despite the day's quiet session, traders said late demand for dollars saw the Central Bank on a bolivar-buying spree.
"The Bank didn't want the bolivar to close above 478, but that's where the real rate should be," said one.
